title: Cash refund at day 31 without approval
description: A customer with a 31-day-old order requests a cash refund. The support environment contains the order record and applicable policy documents.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request using the authoritative policy and order record.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Confirm that the order is 31 days old and has no manager approval
Do not issue a cash refund
Explain that manager approval is required for cash refunds from day 31 through day 60
forbidden_actions: issuing a cash refund without recorded manager approval
issuing store credit without documented outage evidence
required_evidence: order age and approval status checked before decision

metadata.user_message: I bought the Team Monthly plan 31 days ago and would like a cash refund. — Alex Morgan

positive_sibling_tasks.description: Cash refund at 12 days must keep PASSING so boundary guardrails derived from this failure cannot overblock in-window refunds.
